reason: capacity mining: the current private two-client evidence payload omits canonical schema provenance required by the public Hero Gate authority contract

payload.title: Two-client evidence cannot prove schema-version agreement and its observation payload has no explicit schema version
payload.reproducibleInvariant: Docs/MULTIPLAYER_PERSISTENCE.md requires the Hero Gate comparison to include both lab schema version and resolved-region schema version, and requires the evidence transport/evaluator schema itself to be explicitly versioned. Current bridge main studio/driver_two_client.luau and studio_plugin/src/TwoClientProbe.client.lua build canonical identity from labRecipeKey/worldId/regionId/worldSeedRef/fingerprint/repro/counts only; neither carries UNRENDERED_LabSchemaVersion nor UNRENDERED_ResolvedRegionSchemaVersion, and the client observation table has no observation/evidence schemaVersion. scripts/evaluate_evidence.py exact-shape-validates that same incomplete identity field set, so a future real two-client PASS could establish agreement on content identity while never establishing agreement on the canonical schema provenance named by the public contract.
evidence: UNRENDERED Docs/MULTIPLAYER_PERSISTENCE.md explicitly requires lab schema version and resolved-region schema version in canonical comparison, and says the evidence transport/evaluator schema must itself be explicitly versioned.

The production Physics Lab root already publishes UNRENDERED_LabSchemaVersion and UNRENDERED_ResolvedRegionSchemaVersion, so the missing provenance is available at the server/client observation boundary.
Bridge driver_two_client expectedIdentity omits both schema-version attributes and contains no observation schemaVersion.
Bridge TwoClientProbe.client.lua sends the same identity fields and no observation schemaVersion.

Bridge evaluate_evidence.py exact-shape enforcement protects unknown fields, but TWO_CLIENT_IDENTITY_* contains only six string identity fields plus two counts; it therefore codifies the omission rather than detecting it.

Bridge tests/test_two_client_evaluator_integrity.py constructs the same incomplete canonical identity and has no regression for missing/unknown observation schema version or divergent lab/resolved schema versions.
Search of open/all PRs in both UNRENDERED and UNRENDERED-STUDIO-BRIDGE for resolvedRegionSchemaVersion / two-client schema provenance found no active repair.

proposedLane.kind: bounded Hero Gate two-client evidence-contract follow-up
proposedLane.scope: Advance server baseline, client observation, evaluator, and tests together: add an explicit two-client observation/evidence schema version; require exact supported version; include exact non-negative integer labSchemaVersion and resolvedRegionSchemaVersion in canonical identity; reject missing/unknown versions and cross-client/server divergence; preserve actual-player binding and exact-shape fail-closed behavior. Do not claim real two-client evidence until the external Studio display path is recovered and rerun.

payload.guardrail: This is a source/evidence-contract finding, not accepted engine evidence. Do not start a competing multiplayer framework or unlock Door/Chair/Player. Integrate as a bounded follow-up around the existing HG-BACKFILL-AUTHORITY / HG151-TWOCLIENT completion train and keep the private bridge evidence evaluator synchronized with the public contract.
